verdicts.reason: A: the logo and jar are shrunk to an unreadable speck under the legal block, the 'CLINICALLY TESTED' eyebrow sits below the subcopy (reading order reversed), the legal text is a cramped column pressed against the leaf strip, and the CTA floats in a dead middle gap. B: the headline and subcopy sit directly on the faded leaf background (text on imagery), and the bottom row crams CTA, jar, logo and eyebrow together, with the eyebrow out of order. The legal column is still microscopic, but the brand mark is legible and the headline is the clear focal point, so B is the less broken of the two.
